description: L.I.O.N.E.L contract set v1. Authored at Phase 0 / M2, before any implementation exists. See contracts/README.md for the compatibility policy.

negotiation.rule: Compare major versions at connect. Server major greater than host major is refused at connect, never at first call.

cross_cutting.transport: in-process; serialized for telemetry and audit
cross_cutting.note: Event is the base envelope every other event specializes. Changing it is the highest-blast-radius change in the contract set.

control.transport: MCP over stdio (L0) or Streamable HTTP (L1+)
control.note: MCPTool is a PROJECTION of the ToolSpec IR, not a second source of truth. Authorization metadata (side_effect, trust_required) is deliberately withheld from the wire — emitting it would tell a remote peer which tool is the soft target.

internal.transport: in-process; serialized for telemetry and audit

data_descriptors.transport: data plane only; also the ADR-0027 fixture format
data_descriptors.note: Separate namespace so the no-PCM-on-the-control-plane invariant stays checkable. Putting these in events/ would have made the invariant check fail, and the tempting fix would have been to weaken the check.

data_wire.transport: gRPC bidirectional streaming over HTTP/2, mTLS at L2+

invariants: No audio or image PAYLOAD appears in any control-plane schema. Descriptors live in media/, payload_b64 is fixtures-only. ADR-0006.
No schema permits free text destined for a shell interpreter. ADR-0011.
Every ToolSpec declares side_effect and trust_required; the registry rejects tools that do not. ADR-0026, ADR-0012.
MCPTool never carries side_effect, trust_required, rate limits or audit flags. Authorization metadata does not leave the system.
Trust is monotonically non-increasing within a turn. ToolResult.trust_of_output and MemoryQueryResult.trust_floor are both required so no path can restore it. ADR-0012.
turn_id is present on every event and doubles as the OpenTelemetry trace id. ADR-0019.
policy defaults.decision is pinned to deny by const. ADR-0012.
memory.forget is a required tool, never optional. ADR-0010.
Every schema declares version, plane, owner, producer, consumers and compatibility notes.

compatibility.configuration: Unknown keys are an ERROR. ADR-0015.
compatibility.protobuf: Removed field numbers are permanently reserved. Never reused.

ownership.escalation: Any change to a `stable` contract requires an ADR and Efe's approval regardless of owner. Ownership decides who drafts it, not who may skip it.
